note: Run in order; each experiment reuses cached normalisation/blocking/features when those settings (and the code) are unchanged. Add or edit freely. Results go to experiments/results.tsv; `compare` picks the best untouched-holdout macro F0.5 (within 0.001 of the best, fewer candidates wins). Model-only experiments take minutes; blocking experiments (max_df/key_budget/prelim) rebuild blocking and features and take much longer.
